title: Factorial Monoids and (N,x): An Axiomatic Characterization — Lean 4 Formalization

creators.name: Zambrano, Eduardo
creators.affiliation: California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo

description: A complete, sorry-free Lean 4 formalization of the paper 'Factorial Monoids and (N,x): An Axiomatic Characterization' (E. Zambrano, under review at Semigroup Forum). Main theorem, machine-checked over reducedness alone: a reduced commutative monoid is factorial if and only if it satisfies (WFD) well-founded divisibility, (TD) tower disjointness, and (CFI) coprime factorization independence; adding (CCA) coprime coverage of the atoms characterizes the multiplicative positive integers exactly. Every numbered statement of the paper carries its Lean identifier; the five independence counterexamples are fully verified; an axiom audit shows all headline theorems depend only on propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. An interactive dependency map of the proof accompanies the repository.
